the_mathematical_reason.old_edge_formula: old edge = no-vig p - 1/decimal(price) = -p x (overround - 1) for a proportional margin: it is the side's own share of the margin, linear in p, and carries no hockey information
the_mathematical_reason.reading: with the log's mean overround of 1.0433 every side the market puts above 46.2% reads as NEGATIVE (a margin of two points or more) and every side below it as NEUTRAL: favourites are demoted and underdogs promoted by arithmetic alone

caveats: A small sample: results by class are shown with their sizes and intervals and prove nothing about skill.
The hockey model's disagreement threshold uses the evidence file's disagreement spread, which was measured on this same log (a minor look-ahead on one constant).
No historical closing prices exist: a flat stake at the logged price is not a measure of edge.
Same-game sides are not independent: both sides of a game are one outcome.
